items.q: how we became friends. He asked me, he says, 'I like you. I like the way you talk.'

ctx.x: This is Tape Number Twelve of Chuck Green.
Yeah, well, as I was saying, Mr. Bill

Bojangles Robinson, how we became friends. He asked me, he says, "I like you. I like the way you talk. Who are you? Who is your father? Who is your mother? Who is your sister? Who is your brother? Where are you from? Do you play pool?" Said, "Seems like I know you." "What do they call you?" So I told him, "Well, they used to call me Shorty." I said, "I remember you from that night at the gaming room." He laughed and said, "Oh, yeah. You was that pool shooter there's partner. You was with this same man that was…
